note: All-path clocks include cost-dominated paths; compulsory intervals are necessary resource cuts. The timed model retains complete cost/latest-departure frontiers and necessary E1 supply links; physical E2 sequencing is still relaxed. All recovered upper bounds pass the full audit. Partial universes skip the joint stage. Independent prefix replay checks all enumerated task-set minimum costs; every exported full LP matrix is checked and reoptimized. No complete M5 integer optimality or infeasibility proof follows from LP convergence.
